headline: Rebuild Diagnostic Equipment supply — target 75% of the ₹67,794/month lost since October 2025.
rationale: Diagnostic Equipment was 20.4% of baseline revenue and has been at zero for 10 months — a clean, nameable loss, not a general decline. ₹677,943 has already gone. The 31.6% price-concession tolerance makes a strong win-back ask commercially safe.
why_not_more_aggressive: Full 100% win-back assumes the whole category returns in one move after 10 months at zero — a phased target is more credible.
why_not_less_aggressive: 50% or 33% win-back leaves ₹31,893 or ₹43,418/month unrecovered — too little given ₹677,943 already lost.
expected_result: Winning back 75% of Diagnostic Equipment recovers ₹50,846/month in revenue and ₹16,052/month in margin, but still leaves the account ₹14,944/month short of full health.
what_to_do: Call the buyer and open with the stopped line: Diagnostic Equipment, was ₹67,794/month, zero since October 2025.

Name the four discontinued SKUs by figure: DG-Digital Multimeter Pro (was ₹23,651/month), DG-Thermal Imager (was ₹20,009/month), DG-Insulation Tester (was ₹10,095/month), PH-Precision Torque Wrench (was ₹11,473/month).
Offer a phased reinstatement targeting 75% of prior volume (₹50,846/month) with a price concession of up to 31.6%.
Get sign-off from Rohit Sharma's manager on the concession ceiling before the call.
Track monthly recovered revenue against the ₹50,846/month target and margin against ₹16,052/month.
talking_points: Diagnostic Equipment was 20.4% of your baseline, ₹67,794/month, before it stopped in October 2025.
That's ₹677,943 in lost value over 10 months at zero.
We can support up to a 31.6% price concession to get this line moving again.
check_before_acting: Confirm whether the customer discontinued diagnostic equipment purchasing internally or moved to another supplier.
Confirm any contract or tender cycle governing this category before proposing new terms.
Confirm current relationship status and last contact point with the buyer for this category.
what_is_left_over: A shortfall of ₹14,944/month remains even at 75% win-back; closing it needs either the remaining 25% of Diagnostic Equipment or addressing the separate declines in Power Tools, Precision Hardware and Fasteners & Fittings.
downside_if_wrong: If the customer has structurally moved away, the concession is offered without volume returning, eroding margin for nothing.
how_we_will_know_it_worked: Diagnostic Equipment revenue moves from ₹0 toward ₹50,846/month — check at 3 months.
Margin recovers toward ₹16,052/month — check at 3 months.
Value lost so far stops growing past ₹677,943 — check monthly.
